messages:
Maria (CS): Heads-up — NewHaven wanted to onboard a custom 13B summarizer for clinical intake triage. They asked for private deployment + HSM for keys and PHI scoping. Also flagged renewal risk if we can't meet latency targets.
Alex J (Solutions): Got it. Do we have the model artifact or is this a fine-tuning request?
Maria (CS): They're bringing a fine-tuned checkpoint (Torch .pt) + training spec. Key asks: 1) private VPC, 2) HSM + KMS, 3) <200ms tail latency p95 for 256-token summaries, 4) safety evals on our PHI test-suite.
Eli (CS): Adding that renewal risk note — their CSM said they expect GA in 8 weeks to hit Q3 contract renewal. If we slip, they're likely to consider other vendors.
Priya (Enablement): We'll need a playbook for their support team. Can we schedule an enablement session + runbook for fallback (e.g., lower-capacity async path) if p95 spikes?
Sam O (SRE): Two quick items: does the model support KV cache-friendly attention? That affects latency. Also need estimated RPS and concurrency to size Dedicated nodes.
Maria (CS): NewHaven says expected peak 12rps, typical 3rps, concurrency up to 8. Model uses standard causal transformer layers; they didn't optimize KV caching yet.
Alex J (Solutions): Can we ask them for a small perf sample (100 inference requests) and a representative prompt set? We'll run a local bench on a 80GB A100 to estimate p95 and memory.
Maria (CS): Requesting sample now. Also they want our safety checklist run and a whitebox review of fine-tuning data for PHI leakage risk.
Priya (Enablement): I'll draft an enablement agenda: onboarding, obs (Console), fallbacks, incident escalation matrix. Want to run it next Wed — anyone blocked?
Sam O (SRE): Next Wed works for SRE. For rollout: propose canary on Dedicated with autoscale up to 2 nodes, KV cache enabled, and fallback to lower-quantized variant if latency > 250ms for 10m window.
Alex J (Solutions): For HSM/KMS: need PO contact to sign the network & key-access forms. Also confirm whether they want on-prem HSM or cloud-managed.
Maria (CS): PO is Dana Park — looped in via email. They prefer cloud-managed HSM but need SOC2 + contract addendum.
Eli (CS): Safety evals: we'll use the PHI redaction probe + hallucination regression tests. Can we schedule an initial baseline eval this week once we have sample prompts?
Priya (Enablement): I'll capture feedback and make a recording plan for the enablement session to use in renewal materials.
Alex J (Solutions): Two config snippets we'll ask for from the model team:
```
model_config:
  max_seq_len: 2048
  kv_cache_optimized: false
  quantization_profile: none
```
Send if they can enable kv_cache_optimized=true and provide a 1k prompt latency sample.
deploy-bot: Note: security review required for PHI-handling models. Create ticket: SEC-12987.
Maria (CS): Created a tracking row: action items -> 1) perf sample (NewHaven) 2) HSM + contract details (Maria) 3) Safety evals (Eli) 4) Enablement agenda (Priya) 5) Sizing + canary plan (Sam). I'll update customer-facing timeline once we have perf numbers.
Eli (CS): Also flag for Product — if p95 can't reach 200ms we should discuss fallback SLA terms with the customer to avoid renewal churn.
Priya (Enablement): I'll draft the enablement invite and share materials in #customer-onboarding.
Alex J (Solutions): Next step: Maria to share sample prompts and artifact link. I'll queue local bench once received.
Maria (CS): Sharing sample now. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
